sections.text:
Ability Power 140. Damages all enemies 5 times with magic star damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases ATK and MATK of all allies by 80% for 60 seconds.
-Increases ATK and MATK buff limits of all allies by 20 for 60 seconds.
-Decreases ATK and MATK of all allies by 20% for 60 seconds. [Demerit]
-Increases DEF and MDEF of all enemies by 40% for 60 seconds. [Demerit]
-Increases Unison gauge gains for all allies by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Recovers 25 Cost for your character.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
